prose: Simon Willison notes a new release of pwasm, his vibe-coded pure Python WebAssembly engine from January, and the prompt he gave a coding agent: assess its state, consider what it would take to run the MicroPython and micro JavaScript experiments on it, and how to speed it up. Only the opening was read.
highlights: pwasm is a vibe-coded pure Python WebAssembly engine.
Agent asked to assess it and plan speedups.
